# ISM Design System

> Source of truth for International Scripture Ministries (ISM) and dot.Bible interfaces: design tokens, written rules, 79 component specs, and code libraries for HTML/CSS, React, Next.js, React Native, iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Compose). Paths are relative to the repository root.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): order of authority, how to build a screen, non-negotiable rules
- [README.md](README.md): overview and install

## Machine-readable
- [tokens/tokens.json](tokens/tokens.json): all design tokens (colour, type, spacing, radius, shadow, gradient, layout, z-index, motion, opacity, size, scripts)
- [packages/tokens/tokens.flat.json](packages/tokens/tokens.flat.json): flat name/value list
- [rules/rules.json](rules/rules.json): states, multilingual and RTL, layout, icons and links, accessibility (with approved contrast pairs), voice, and `applied` (print, decks, email, social)
- [specs/index.json](specs/index.json): list of all components with group, summary and platform support
- [specs/all.json](specs/all.json): every component spec in one file (anatomy, variants, props, states, do and don't, snippets)
- components/<Name>/spec.json: one component spec; components/<Name>/README.md: the authored source

## Rules (prose)
- [rules/states.md](rules/states.md): default, hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading, error
- [rules/multilingual-rtl.md](rules/multilingual-rtl.md): Noto fallbacks, line-height per script, mirroring for Arabic, Urdu, Farsi
- [rules/layout-motion.md](rules/layout-motion.md): breakpoints, containers, z-index, elevation, motion
- [rules/icons-links.md](rules/icons-links.md): ⌄ opens, ↗ goes to another page, › drills in, → continues
- [rules/accessibility.md](rules/accessibility.md): contrast, focus ring, 44px targets, alt text, semantics
- [rules/voice-microcopy.md](rules/voice-microcopy.md): button verbs, error tone, referring to Scripture
- [rules/print-editorial.md](rules/print-editorial.md): brochures, reports, media kits
- [rules/decks.md](rules/decks.md): slide decks
- [rules/email.md](rules/email.md): donor, lifecycle and transactional email
- [rules/social.md](rules/social.md): social (thin, observed only)

## Code
- [packages/web/css/ism.css](packages/web/css/ism.css): all tokens and component CSS in one file; [packages/web/css/rtl.css](packages/web/css/rtl.css): RTL overrides
- [packages/react/src/components](packages/react/src/components): React components (@ism/ui)
- [packages/react-native/src/components](packages/react-native/src/components): React Native components (@ism/ui-native)
- [packages/ios/Sources/ISMDesignSystem](packages/ios/Sources/ISMDesignSystem): SwiftUI package
- [packages/android/ism-design-system/src/main/kotlin/bible/ism/design](packages/android/ism-design-system/src/main/kotlin/bible/ism/design): Jetpack Compose module
- [examples/next-app](examples/next-app): minimal Next.js App Router example

## Optional
- [docs/design-system-overview.md](docs/design-system-overview.md): original overview
- [reference](reference): legacy UI kits and templates, kept for reference only
